title: JAX-Sen: Placenta Collection, Processing, and Shipment Protocol for Spatial Transcriptomics
author: Alicia Warren
materials: Separate individual yolk sac containing fetus and embryos

steps.title: Euthanize dam and record start time
steps.instruction: Euthanize the pregnant mouse by cervical dislocation and immediately record the start time.

steps.title: Open abdomen, euthanize fetuses, collect limb
steps.instruction: Carefully open the female abdomen without damaging fetuses; if fetuses are older than embryonic day 15 (E15), euthanize them by decapitation, then remove the hind left limb from one fetus per litter and keep the limb in 1× PBS until imaging for limb staging.

substeps.instruction: Open abdomen gently to avoid fetal damage
Remove hind left limb from one fetus per litter
Place limb in 1× PBS until ready for imaging

steps.title: Isolate placenta, remove excess tissue, measure
steps.instruction: Dissect the placenta, removing any unnecessary tissue such as yolk sac and uterine wall; excise the thin tissue layer on the side attached to the umbilical cord (do not remove the similar layer on the opposite side), then measure (in mm) the placenta diameter and the embryo crown‑to‑rump length (CRL).

substeps.instruction: Remove yolk sac and uterine wall from placenta
Excise tissue layer connected to umbilical cord (retain opposite side layer)

steps.title: Submerge placenta in 10% NBF fixative
steps.instruction: Place the whole placenta into a scintillation vial (or other appropriate container) filled with 10 % neutral buffered formalin (NBF) prepared in PBS (FFPE solution), ensuring the placenta is completely submerged.

steps.title: Fix placenta on shaker for 24 h
steps.instruction: Transfer the vial to a rocker or shaker at room temperature and fix the placenta for exactly 24 hours.

steps.title: Collect embryo tissue for genotyping
steps.instruction: From the same embryo, dissect a small piece of tail (or other tissue) for genotyping and a second piece as backup; place both pieces on wet ice.

steps.title: Transfer placenta to cassette and cold PBS
steps.instruction: After the 24‑hour fixation, move the placenta into a labelled cassette, then place the cassette into 1× PBS kept at 4 °C and RNase‑free; clean all tools before proceeding to the next animal and record the time when the last sample is collected.

substeps.instruction: Transfer fixed placenta to labelled cassette

steps.title: Embed placenta in paraffin and orient
steps.instruction: Embed the placenta in paraffin, trim the block to expose tissue, and orient the disc‑shaped placenta upright (not flat) within the block.

substeps.instruction: Place placenta disc upright in the block

steps.title: Seal blocks, protect from light, ship
steps.instruction: Seal the paraffin blocks, protect them from light when possible, and ship them on cold packs to Jackson Laboratory for Genomic Medicine, Farmington, CT 06032, maintaining the samples at 4 °C during transport.

substeps.instruction: Ship to Jackson Laboratory, keep at 4 °C
